description: Pipeline Flow dual layout. Unhealthy: blockers + taxonomy first. Healthy: empty blockers are VALID EMPTY, not a dead-end. Telemetry confidence is the metrics-trust/scrape confidence chip (not peer health).

options.content: 0. Trust1. Overview2. Pipeline Diagnostics (current)3. Provider Health4. Data Quality5. Incident Workspace6. Run Explorer

panels.title: Navigate Dashboards
panels.description: Sanitizer-compatible navigation bus with native keyboard focus. Primary bus 0–4: Trust / Overview / Pipeline Diagnostics / Provider Health / Data Quality. Adjunct 5–6: Incident Workspace / Run Explorer. Current workspace is a non-interactive chip (aria-disabled + data-current=page, underlined) so active state is not color-only. Handoffs open same-tab, preserve current time range, and document scope reset or context mapping on cross-scope transitions. Chip colors are theme-safe for dark and light

panels.title: Understand Pipeline Scope
panels.description: Distinguishes CURRENT Prometheus state, SELECTED RUN HTTP evidence, and selected-range history for Pipeline and Run Type. Run ID never filters Prometheus; Stage and collection states are context, not delivery proof. UNKNOWN means evidence is incomplete

options.content:
Is the pipeline progressing, and what is blocking delivery?
Scope: CURRENT = health/phase/blockers · SELECTED RUN = ID/accounting
STAGE = diagnostic context · SCRAPING does not mean delivery OK

panels.title: Monitor Pipeline Status
panels.description: Shows the sole current Pipeline Health verdict. Status mapping: 0=OK, 1=WARN, >=2=CRIT, null=UNKNOWN. A telemetry gap makes the verdict incomplete; use First Action and Runtime Blockers to continue

panels.title: Start Pipeline Triage
panels.description: States the current verdict and neutral outcome explicitly, then routes non-OK states through runtime blockers, DQ evidence, and Run Explorer.

options.content: First action: OK + SCRAPING + no blocker → continue monitoring. Otherwise open the highest-severity blocker; verify coverage before trusting an empty blocker table.

panels.description: Lists current runtime blockers for Pipeline and Run Type. An empty list is healthy only when Pipeline Health is OK and Metrics Coverage is complete; otherwise it is inconclusive. Open the matching detection or localization panel
panels.title: Review Runtime Blockers

panels.description: Shows Prometheus scrape vs recording-rule/series coverage. Mapping: 0=SCRAPING (metrics present), 1=RULE/SERIES GAP (pipeline_runs_total absent or BioETL rule-group stale/failing), 2=RULE+SERIES GAP (both), null=UNKNOWN. Value 1 is inconclusive about scrape-target health: the job can be up while rules/series are missing. This is evidence confidence, not Pipeline Health.
panels.title: Monitor Metrics Coverage
Inspect Detection Signals

panels.description: Shows selected-range stage backlog by Stage for Pipeline and Run Type. An empty chart can mean no backlog samples or missing telemetry, not a healthy zero. Use current blocker and coverage panels to decide which case applies
panels.title: Track Stage Backlog Trend

panels.description: Shows selected-range processed records by Stage for Pipeline and Run Type. An empty chart means no matching samples or unavailable telemetry; it does not prove successful delivery. Run ID never filters Prometheus
panels.title: Track Records by Stage / Interval

panels.description: Lists current runtime blocker rules for Pipeline and applicable Run Type labels. An empty table is valid only when Pipeline Health is OK and Metrics Coverage is complete; otherwise inspect telemetry or selector scope

defaults.noValue: No blocker rows. Trust this only when Runtime Status is OK and Telemetry Gap is clean.

panels.title: Inspect Active Runtime Blocker Detail
Track Stage Lag
panels.description: Shows selected-range stage lag in seconds for Pipeline, Run Type, and Stage. No data means no emitted lag samples or unavailable telemetry, never zero lag. Use Worst Stage Lag and current blockers for severity

Compares expected and observed stages for the selected Pipeline. Gold can be expected, disabled, pending while a run is active, or missing after completion; these are context states, not delivery proof. Use Run Explorer for exact-run chronology
panels.title: Inspect Stage Expectedness

panels.description: Shows the current 30-minute Runtime Error Rate for Pipeline; Run Type does not affect this panel. Below 5%=OK, >=5%=WARN, >=20%=CRIT when the Bronze denominator is at least 20; insufficient or missing input is UNKNOWN. Review errors by Stage and code next
panels.title: Monitor Runtime Error Rate

panels.description: Contains current detection evidence and selected-range trends for the active Pipeline scope. These panels support Pipeline Health; Run ID never filters Prometheus

panels.title: Localize Runtime Cause

panels.description: Shows p50, p95, and p99 phase duration for the selected Pipeline and range. Run Type does not affect this panel. No data can mean an active run, no emitted samples, or a label mismatch; it is not zero duration

defaults.noValue: No phase duration samples in range

panels.title: Track Phase Duration

panels.description: Shows p50, p95, and p99 completed pipeline duration by Stage for Pipeline and Run Type over the selected range. No data can mean an active run, no terminal samples, unavailable telemetry, or a label mismatch; it is not zero duration

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, stage, status, run_type) (rate(bioetl_pipeline_duration_seconds_bucket{pipeline=~"(${pipeline:regex}|workflow_${pipeline:regex})",run_type=~"$run_type",stage=~"$stage"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, stage, status, run_type) (rate(bioetl_pipeline_duration_seconds_bucket{pipeline=~"(${pipeline:regex}|workflow_${pipeline:regex})",run_type=~"$run_type",stage=~"$stage"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, stage, status, run_type) (rate(bioetl_pipeline_duration_seconds_bucket{pipeline=~"(${pipeline:regex}|workflow_${pipeline:regex})",run_type=~"$run_type",stage=~"$stage"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Track Pipeline Duration

panels.description: Lists selected-range error samples grouped by Stage and error code for Pipeline and Run Type. An empty table means no matching samples, not guaranteed Pipeline Health. Check Metrics Coverage before treating it as valid empty evidence
panels.title: Review Errors by Stage & Code

panels.description: Compares selected-range processed-record totals by Stage and Run Type for the selected Pipeline. An empty chart means no matching samples or unavailable telemetry, not successful processing. Use Run Explorer for exact-run counts
panels.title: Compare Records by Stage & Run Type

panels.description: Contains selected-range duration, error, and record evidence used to localize a runtime cause. These panels support but do not independently determine current Pipeline Health

panels.title: Review Escalation Paths
Review Runtime Escalation

options.content:
Runtime escalation: blockers → phase evidence → action.
Use Incident Workspace for multi-domain impact; Run Explorer for exact-run proof.

panels.description: Contains Runtime-owned failure, no-records, and memory-pressure signals. A zero is conclusive only when Metrics Coverage is complete; otherwise verify telemetry before following the relevant runbook or Run Explorer path

Summarizes Runtime-owned preflight, infrastructure, failed-run, and error-rate conditions for Pipeline and Run Type. Zero means no condition is firing only when coverage and selected scope exist; UNKNOWN is inconclusive. Review active blocker detail next. Measured 0 requires present series; No data means metric/series absence and must not be treated as healthy zero.
panels.title: Monitor Pipeline Alert Conditions

panels.description: Shows no-records runs from the last 30 minutes for Pipeline and Run Type. Zero is valid only when runs and telemetry exist; UNKNOWN, no matching scope, or a run not started is inconclusive. Inspect checkpoint/resume and stage expectedness next

targets.expr: sum(((sum by (pipeline, run_type) (increase(bioetl_pipeline_runs_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline",run_type=~"$run_type"}[30m])) > 0) unless on (pipeline, run_type) (sum by (pipeline, run_type) (increase(bioetl_records_processed_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline",run_type=~"$run_type"}[30m])) > 0))) or ((count(bioetl_runtime_pipeline_run_type_universe{pipeline=~"$pipeline",run_type=~"$run_type"}) > bool 0) * 0)

panels.title: Monitor No-Records Runs

panels.description: Shows current memory-pressure state by Pipeline and Stage. Mapping: 0=OK, 1=WARN, >=2=CRIT, null=UNKNOWN; Run Type does not affect this panel. Review structured report files and checkpoint/resume pressure before retrying
panels.title: Monitor Memory Pressure Active
Review Cross-Domain Handoffs

options.content: Cross-domain handoffs — Provider (deps) · DQ (rejects) · Trust (replay) · Incident (ranked triage). Preserve scope variables.

panels.description: Contains handoff evidence for Data Quality, Trust, Provider Health, and freshness. These panels do not diagnose the target domain; zero is conclusive only when its telemetry anchor is present

Shows Data Quality handoff conditions for the selected Pipeline. Zero means no condition is firing only when DQ telemetry is present; UNKNOWN is inconclusive. Open Data Quality for rule, threshold, and Silver reject evidence. Measured 0 requires present series; No data means metric/series absence and must not be treated as healthy zero.
panels.title: Inspect DQ Alert Conditions

panels.description: Shows Trust handoff conditions for manifest, checkpoint, replay, and lineage evidence for Pipeline and Run Type. Zero is conclusive only when telemetry is present; UNKNOWN is inconclusive. Open Trust to decide replay or resume safety
panels.title: Inspect Control Plane Alert Conditions

panels.description: Shows provider conditions for the provider inferred from the selected Pipeline. Zero is valid only when that provider scope and telemetry exist; UNKNOWN means a missing or unknown provider hint. Open Provider Health for diagnosis

dataLinks.title: Open 3. Provider Health
dataLinks.tooltip: Context mapping: provider=unknown, pipeline_context=$pipeline, adapter=unknown. Provider alert query may scope by $provider_hint when validated.

panels.title: Inspect Provider Alert Conditions

panels.description: Shows global provider-independent latency and rate-limiter conditions. Pipeline and Run Type filters do not affect this panel. Zero is valid only when provider telemetry exists; UNKNOWN means the global provider anchor is missing

dataLinks.title: Open 3. Provider Health
dataLinks.tooltip: Context mapping: provider=unknown, pipeline_context=$pipeline, adapter=unknown. GLOBAL card sums cluster-wide adapter latency and rate-limiter wait conditions.

panels.title: Inspect Global Provider Alert Conditions

panels.description: Counts selected-Pipeline entities with freshness lag over 24 hours. Zero means none are stale only when freshness telemetry is available; UNKNOWN means target-domain evidence is missing. Open Data Quality or Provider Health for diagnosis
panels.title: Inspect Entities Stale Over 24h
Review Global Process Signals

options.content: Process-level (GLOBAL) — memory/error process signals are fleet evidence, not selected-run health. Pair with pipeline Status.

panels.description: Contains selected-range process-level shutdown evidence. Pipeline and Run Type filters do not affect these panels; they provide context and do not determine Pipeline Health

Shows global graceful-shutdown starts grouped by reason over the selected range. Pipeline and Run Type filters do not affect this panel. An empty chart can mean no starts or unavailable telemetry; compare with completions without treating it as an alert verdict
panels.title: Track Global Shutdown Starts

panels.description: Shows global graceful-shutdown completions grouped by reason over the selected range. Pipeline and Run Type filters do not affect this panel. An empty chart can mean no completions or unavailable telemetry; compare with starts for incomplete shutdown context
panels.title: Track Global Shutdown Completions

panels.description: Contains Runtime-owned escalation signals and handoffs to other domain dashboards. Use it after detection and localization identify the likely owner

panels.title: Inspect Secondary Runtime Indicators

panels.description: Shows the worst stage lag over the last 15 minutes for Pipeline and Run Type across all stages. Mapping: <300s=OK, 300–899s=WARN, >=900s=CRIT, null=UNKNOWN. No data is missing lag evidence; inspect stage lag and backlog next
panels.title: Monitor Worst Stage Lag

panels.description: Counts active canonical runtime blockers over the last 15 minutes for Pipeline and Run Type. This is a count: 0=OK only with healthy status and coverage, >=1=CRIT, null=UNKNOWN. Inspect blocker detail for the owning condition
panels.title: Monitor Runtime Blockers

panels.description: Counts failed runs over the selected window for Pipeline and Run Type. Zero means no matching failures only when telemetry and scope exist; No data or UNKNOWN is inconclusive. Use the failure runbook or Run Explorer
panels.title: Monitor Failed Runs

panels.description: Contains secondary lag, blocker-count, and failed-run evidence. These panels support the first-screen Pipeline Health verdict and stay collapsed until the primary path requires more context

panels.title: Inspect Run Context
Inspect Pipeline Identity
panels.description: Shows HTTP-backed identity for an exact Run ID. Aggregate Pipeline scope does not guess a run. No matching rows are a valid empty result for the selected scope; backend unavailable means the query could not be evaluated. Verify /health/live and continue in Run Explorer

defaults.noValue: SELECT RUN — no exact Run ID selected. Choose a run first. VALID EMPTY if the selected run has no identity.

panels.title: Inspect Processed Records
panels.description: Shows HTTP-backed Bronze input, Silver accepted/rejected, and Gold output counts and outcomes. Zero is a recorded count. No matching rows can mean a valid empty result, unresolved scope, or backend failure (backend unavailable); verify /health/live and use Run Explorer before classifying the result.

defaults.noValue: SELECT RUN — no exact Run ID selected. Choose a run in Inspect Recent Runs. UNKNOWN/QUERY ERROR if a selected run has no accounting.

panels.description: Contains compact HTTP-backed evidence for the selected run. Run Explorer is the canonical exact-run surface; aggregate scope does not guess an exact manifest, and Run ID never becomes a Prometheus label

panels.title: Inspect Workflow Evidence
Track Failed Workflow Runs
panels.description: Counts failed Workflow runs in the selected range for Workflow and Pipeline. Zero means no matching failures in the selected range, including when an empty selected-range result is rendered through noValue; it is neutral range evidence, not current Workflow or Pipeline Health. Use runtime localization or Trust evidence when non-zero, and use Metrics Evidence to assess telemetry confidence.

panels.title: Track Failed Workflow Steps
panels.description: Counts failed Workflow pipeline steps in the selected range for Workflow and Pipeline. The metric has no Stage label. Zero means no matching failures in the selected range, including when an empty selected-range result is rendered through noValue; it is neutral range evidence, not stage success or current Pipeline Health. Use runtime localization or Trust evidence when non-zero, and use Metrics Evidence to assess telemetry confidence.
Contains selected-range workflow failure evidence merged into Pipeline Diagnostics. These panels support localization and do not determine current Pipeline Health

list.description: Shared operator context: workflow evidence selector. This selector does not imply exact current-status intersection unless the dashboard explicitly documents that semantics.
list.label: Workflow
list.name: workflow

list.label: Pipeline
list.name: pipeline
list.description: Core scope: pipeline selector from canonical runtime pipeline/run_type universe, including runs that emitted no records. Single-select; no All scope. Unknown is the explicit fail-closed default.

list.label: Run Type
list.name: run_type
list.description: Core scope: run_type selector bounded by canonical runtime pipeline/run_type universe; fallback: All run types for selected pipeline. Default run_type is backfill (SEL-P0 fallback); Include All remains available for aggregate diagnostics.

Shared operator identity context sourced from the local control-plane run-manifest catalog. The selector defaults to - and affects only local HTTP identity panels; it MUST NOT be used in Prometheus labels or cross-dashboard handoffs. Run ID options are ordered by start time descending from the control-plane catalog; Grafana sort is disabled so backend order is preserved.
list.label: Run ID
list.name: run_id

list.label: Stage
list.name: stage
list.description: Core scope: stage selector from expected-stage config so no-record runs still expose stage choices; fallback: All stages for selected pipeline.
Hidden heuristic: first pipeline name segment mapped to provider when it exists in bioetl_provider_current_status; otherwise unknown. Used for provider alert scoping only.
